entries.english: Privileges of German emperors for the owners of the market and town of Niederstetten. Copies. Date range: 1340, 1367, 1530, 1559. Contents: (1) In 1367 Emperor Charles IV permits Götz von Hohenlohe to make the market of Niederstetten a town. (2) In 1530 Emperor Charles V, at Zaisolph von Rosenberg's request, confirms Emperor Louis's town-law privilege, dated 1340. (3) In 1559 Emperor Ferdinand I, at Zaisolph von Rosenberg's request, confirms Emperor Louis's town-law privilege, dated 1340. Extent: 5 documents.
